name: Collections_SynchronizedMap
source_title: Collections (Java SE 25 & JDK 25): Collections.synchronizedMap(Map) API documentation
protocol: synchronizedMap(m) → view(m) → [holdsLock(m)] traversal(view); creation and use of an Iterator, Spliterator, or Stream over a view require holding m's monitor throughout traversal.
important_note: The public JDK documentation requires synchronization on the map returned by Collections.synchronizedMap, rather than on its keySet(), values(), or entrySet() view, when traversing a view. The exact CrySL/JavaMOP source named Collections_SynchronizedMap was not found and consulted; therefore this is a conservative API-documentation summary, not a verified transcription of that specification. The reported io.heckel.ntfy.util.Log.scrub finding is relevant only if the traversed view can be shown to originate from a Collections.synchronizedMap wrapper.

events.name: synchronizedMap
events.condition: Observing this call identifies a possible synchronized-map wrapper. The predicate is satisfied only when the returned map, or a proven alias, is the map m used for the later view and traversal.

events.name: collectionView
events.condition: Observing a view call alone is not a violation and does not prove that the receiver is a synchronized-map wrapper. The relevant predicate is satisfied only when the receiver is proven to alias m.

events.name: iteratorTraversal
events.condition: Observing these calls indicates possible Iterator creation or use. The synchronization predicate is satisfied only if the Iterator is derived from a view of m and the executing thread holds m's monitor for creation and traversal; locking the view object does not satisfy the documented rule.

events.name: spliteratorOrStreamTraversal
events.condition: These calls are documented traversal routes requiring synchronization on m when used over a view of m. A substring match does not prove view provenance, actual traversal, or ownership of m's monitor.

forbidden_inferences_without_evidence: Do not infer that io.heckel.ntfy.util.Log.scrub has an actual data race, concurrent mutation, or nondeterministic runtime behavior.
Do not infer that every Map iterator or collection view is governed by this specification; the map must be shown to originate from Collections.synchronizedMap(Map), directly or through an alias.
Do not infer that locking keySet(), values(), or entrySet() satisfies the documented requirement; the required lock is the synchronized map wrapper.
Do not infer that obtaining a collection view outside a synchronized block is itself a violation; the documented requirement concerns traversal.
Do not infer that replacing the map with ConcurrentHashMap is required; synchronization on the wrapper map for the complete traversal is a documented compliant approach.
Do not infer that all compound Map operations are atomic merely because individual wrapper methods are synchronized; this context concerns collection-view traversal.
Do not infer that the named CrySL/JavaMOP detector itself covers Spliterator or Stream without the unavailable specification source.

detector_examples.message: Collections_SynchronizedMap A collection view of a synchronized map was accessed in a thread-unsafe manner.
